title: Canadian Gratin with Fresh Tomato
description: A simple, comforting side dish featuring a Canadian twist on a classic French recipe.

ingredients.name: 1 cup grated Canadian bacon or ham

instructions: In a skillet, sauté the sliced onions and minced garlic until softened.
Add the sliced tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the grated cheese, flour, and Canadian bacon.
In the prepared baking dish, create a layer of the tomato mixture.
Next, add a layer of the cheese mixture.
Repeat this process until all the ingredients have been used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
